scope: Mission 2005 retry reinforcement walk-off after the bomb destroys the boot-camp wreck
finding: The existing scripted walk-off is triggered only by mission 1995 objective 1. Mission 2005 objective 1 destroys the same wreck and reveals the same three placed reinforcements, but lacked the move trigger. They consequently remained stationary on retry.

evidence.source: original final-week footage 8VXeKzGUv0c, S5P-05 / B2-012, 87.4-98.333 s; docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-footage-events.json
evidence.finding: After the 1995 bomb detonation, reinforcements beam onto the pad. Corrected B2-012 ledger shows them standing on the pad through 98.333 s; the earlier walk-off reading was wrong.
The retry has the same destroy-the-dropship bomb objective and supplies another bomb.

The compatible recovered client completed 2005 objective 1, removed the wreck and revealed Van Valkenberg. This confirms the retry uses the reconstructed destroyed-wreck sequence; it does not establish original retry movement.

correction.reasoning: The retry detonates the same bomb, opens the same wreck and reveals the same squad, so it reuses the observed 1995 walk-off. Location 19854 is already an inferred endpoint 15 m north-east of the pad with +/-5 m uncertainty. The rule introduces no new endpoint or NPC.

limits: No original capture of the 2005 walk-off was found; the retry motion is inferred, not observed final-live behavior.
The exact reinforcement path, endpoint and beam-in timing remain unverified.
